risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight banks' mortgage books; monitor NIM and provision trends; favour dividend-paying defensives

Avoid high-leverage construction and property developers; favour established infrastructure REITs

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy transition cost overrun and gas supply risk
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour integrated energy (WES.AX, XAR.AX) over pure-play renewables; monitor Beetaloo gas pricing

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce bank and housing-linked REIT exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: 15% loan-application drop, record house-price fall forecasts, construction contagion risk from Bathla-type failures

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge rate risk with quality dividend defensives

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid high-leverage construction and property developers
defensive_moves.rationale: Bathla collapse symptomatic of broader Ponzi-style construction financing; ASIC Big Four review adds regulatory overhang

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure as rate-hike expectations collide with a stalling economy. Housing credit contraction and construction-sector fragility weigh on financials and property. Small-cap miners and energy names provide relative outperformance. Volatility elevated ahead of RBA commentary.
market_outlook.long_term: Medium-term outlook cautiously constructive if RBA pauses and housing stabilises. AI capex cycle and critical-mines transition support structural demand. However, energy-transition cost overruns and construction-sector deleveraging pose tail risks. 'Bull case returns' narrative needs macro confirmation.
